# dsh-mobile-pwa

> Complete mobile PWA for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): secure remote access gateway + install-to-homescreen + offline + touch gestures + agent-done push.

## Key facts
- Repo: <you>/dsh-mobile-pwa. MIT license, `dsh-plugin` topic. Derivative of `dsh-mobile-gate` (MIT).
- Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-mobile-pwa`.
- Architecture: standalone child-process Node gateway (zero-dep), reverse-proxies approved LAN/Tailscale devices to DSH on 127.0.0.1; DSH webserver untouched (cannot bind 0.0.0.0). HTML injection adds PWA manifest link, service-worker bootstrap, touch CSS, randomUUID polyfill.
- Gateway serves `/pwa/*` assets (manifest, sw.js, app.css, icons, offline.html) + `/pwa/push/*` (agent-done notifications).
- Env: `LAN_GATE_PORT` (3088), `LAN_GATE_HOST` (0.0.0.0), `LAN_GATE_TARGET_PORT` (3080), `LAN_GATE_RATE_LIMIT` (120), `LAN_GATE_VAPID_PUBLICKEY`.
- Admin: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/lan-gate/admin — approve/deny/revoke devices, pick phone/desktop/auto.
- Security: first-visit approval, one-token-per-browser, 120 req/min per IP, loopback & LAN bypass.
